answer: At the dawn of the network each new agent receives a reputation token that decays unless reinforced by a proof‑of‑work gossip gale of signed attestations from existing members. The protocol squares the weight of each token, so a single seasoned node counts as 1² = 1 while n Sybil identities together contribute only (∑1)² = n², which is dwarfed by the quadratic boost of a few genuine nodes that have accumulated many attestations, turning the attack into a fable of wasted effort.
